decision_authority: explicit_user decisions of 2026-11-15 after the audit_20261115 decision plan: 'R2 seule → shadow' and 'Rétroactif'

supersedes.rule: R0 as shadow trigger, registered on 2026-11-03 (docs/ACTIVE_EIGHT_SLEEVES.md); R0 is kept as an alert
supersedes.reason: in the audit simulation (median of the 9 sleeves, 250 sessions) a shadow trigger 'R0 or R2' cuts 21.1 % of healthy sleeves versus 7.3 % for R2 alone; R0 also cannot fire on the MBT sleeves, whose threshold history extends to 2026-10-02

tracking_start: first session after 2026-11-03 (registry prospective_start_after); h = number of sessions of the sleeve's calendar since that start

R2_shadow.measure: maximum drawdown of the cumulative daily net PnL (USD) since the tracking start, after h sessions
R2_shadow.trigger: maximum drawdown < threshold curve at h (p1 of the stationary-bootstrap max drawdown, mean block 20, 10 000 paths, seed 20261120 + 5)
R2_shadow.beyond_h_500: the curve must be re-estimated by a versioned decision before h = 500 (about November 2028); no extrapolation
R2_shadow.action: the sleeve moves to SHADOW_FORWARD_ONLY in a new versioned lock, without any retuning

R0_alert.measure: sum of the last 126 sessions of daily net PnL
R0_alert.trigger: below the registered threshold (minimum of the same sum over the frozen history)

R3_alert.measure: sum of the last 120 sessions of daily net PnL
R3_alert.trigger: below the p5 of the bootstrap 120-session PnL

book.R2: general review of the book (no automatic action)

rules.review_exit: a sleeve leaves ACTIVE_UNDER_REVIEW when neither R0 nor R3 has fired over the last 120 sessions
rules.reinstatement: only by a new versioned decision after at least 252 sessions in shadow, if the shadow cumulative PnL never fell below its p5(h) and is >= 0 at 252 (audit_20261115/05_regles_arret.md)

retroactive_application.decision: the rule is applied to the replay window 2026-03-20 -> 2026-10-02, on which S04 was moved to shadow on 2026-11-03
retroactive_application.method: audit_20261115/phase6_status.py: R2 on the trailing 250-session max drawdown versus the curve at h = 250; R0 and R3 alerts over the last 120 sessions; data as of 2026-11-01

S09.reasons: R3 du 2026-06-16 au 2026-10-01; classe « négative » sur la validation réutilisée

retroactive_application.book_change: none: no active sleeve reaches R2; S04 stays in shadow (R2 fired 2026-09-09 -> 2026-10-02)

evidence_hash_note: sha256 of the file bytes after replacing CRLF by LF
limits: thresholds estimated on the history already seen, including the reused validation; the bootstrap assumes the past distribution holds; for S01 (trade frequency collapsed in 2026) detection is even slower
